subject: CONTENT GAP AUDIT: RP2/RP3/RP8/RP9 -- 79 items missing, full backlog map
body:
CONTENT GAP AUDIT: RP2, RP3, RP8, RP9

GD ran full content completeness audit on all remaining un-audited exams.

RESULTS SUMMARY:

| Exam | Total Q | fb_correct | fb_wrong | hints |
|------|---------|------------|----------|-------|
| RP2  | 15      | 15 (FULL)  | 12 (GAP) | 15 (FULL) |
| RP3  | 15      | 15 (FULL)  | 12 (GAP) | 15 (FULL) |
| RP8  | 15      | 0  (NONE)  | 15 (FULL)| 15 (FULL) |
| RP9  | 15      | 0  (NONE)  | 15 (FULL)| 15 (FULL) |

COMPLETE BACKLOG ACROSS ALL EXAMS (as of today):

| Exam | fb_correct missing | fb_wrong missing |
|------|--------------------|-----------------|
| RP2  | 0                  | 3 (rp2-q1 q2 q3) |
| RP3  | 0                  | 3 (rp3-q1 q2 q3) |
| RP4  | 0                  | 3 (rp4-q1 q2 q10) |
| RP5  | 0                  | 2 (rp5-q1 q2) |
| RP6  | 0                  | 12 (all but 3) |
| RP7  | 0                  | 9 + 2 fb_correct missing |
| RP8  | 15 (ALL)           | 0 |
| RP9  | 15 (ALL)           | 0 |
| RP10 | 15 (ALL)           | 0 |
| RP1  | COMPLETE (gold standard) | COMPLETE |

TOTAL MISSING: approx 34 fb_wrong + 45 fb_correct = ~79 content items

PRIORITIZATION GUIDANCE:

P1 (block GA publish): RP10 fb_correct -- Kai cannot access this exam yet.
P2 (student-facing gaps): RP2, RP3 fb_wrong Q1-Q3 (Kai is taking these now)
P2 (student-facing gaps): RP6 fb_wrong 12/15 (worst active gap)
P2 (student-facing gaps): RP7 gaps
P3 (pre-launch): RP8, RP9 fb_correct (not yet in dashboard or manifest -- check with GA)
P3 (minor): RP4, RP5 fb_wrong Q1-Q2

PATTERN NOTE:
RP8 + RP9 both have 0 fb_correct -- likely generated in the same batch without that field.
RP10 has the same pattern. These exams were probably created before the fb_correct field
was added to the content spec. Recommend GR adds fb_correct using RP1 as voice standard.

Voice standard for fb_correct (from RP1-q1 as example):
'Motor City! That is correct. [brief explanation of why]. 🏀'

Voice standard for fb_wrong (from RP1-q1 as example):
'Not quite. [what the mistake was]. [correct approach]. 💪'

Max 12 words per feedback per ADHD guidelines (.voice-guide.md).

NEXT STEP: GR, please confirm which exams you are working on first and expected timing.
GA is holding RP10 pending GR sign-off. RP6 is the highest-impact active gap for Kai.
